blocks.text: Every industry milestone is made possible by the people and organizations working together behind the scenes. This collective strength was celebrated at the 5th HIMAP Awards Gala Night, held on November 6, 2026, at the Grand Ballroom A & B of Shangri-La The Fort, BGC, bringing together the Philippine Healthcare Information Management Services (HIMS) community to honor the achievements, leadership, and contributions shaping the sector. Carrying the theme “HIMAYA: Championing and Celebrating Operational Brilliance in HIMS,” the evening recognized the achievements and contributions of individuals and organizations that strengthen the industry.
